## Football Data Visualizations Showcase

Explore a curated collection of football and sports data visualizations built with R. Click on any card to view the full visualization.


```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>

  <meta charset="UTF-8">

  <meta name="viewport"
        content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

  <title>Premier League Transfer Viz</title>

  <!-- D3 -->
  <script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>

  <!-- Your CSS -->
  <link rel="stylesheet"
        href="test.css">

</head>


<body>

<div class="viz-grid">
  <div class="viz-card" onclick="openModal(0)">
    <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/harikrishna19/Football-analysis-24-25/main/images/01-liverpool_infographic.png" alt="Liverpool">
    <div class="viz-card-body">
      <div class="viz-card-title">Liverpool 2024-25</div>
      <div class="viz-card-desc">Formations & goal scorers</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  
<div class="modal-overlay" id="modal">
  <div class="modal-box">
    <button class="modal-close-btn" onclick="closeModal()">&times;</button>
    <img class="modal-image" id="modalImage" src="" alt="">
    <div class="modal-footer">
      <h3 id="modalTitle"></h3>
      <p id="modalDesc"></p>
      <a class="view-source-btn" id="modalLink" href="#" target="_blank">View Source</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

  <script src="test.js"></script>

</body>

</html>
